MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 38
   C. 88
   D. 19

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

3. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 6
   D. 12.5

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 27
   C. 31
   D. 17

5. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 14

6. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 26

7. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x

8. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

9. Solve for x: x + 6 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 18
   C. 12
   D. 6

10. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

11. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/4
   D. 3/4

12. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 22
   D. 11

13. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

14. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 48

15. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

16. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

17. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 46
   C. 23
   D. 120

18. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 28
   C. 3
   D. 11

19. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

20. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.205

21. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.7
   C. 27.6
   D. 33

22. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

23. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 25
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

24. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 169

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
